description: This file defines a factory pattern for creating various types of browser contexts using Playwright, including shared, isolated, CDP, remote, and persistent contexts. It includes utility functions for managing browser instances, injecting scripts, and handling trace servers.

classes.name: BaseContextFactory
classes.description: Base class implementing common logic for creating and managing browser contexts, including obtaining browsers, creating contexts, and cleanup.

classes.name: IsolatedContextFactory
classes.description: Creates isolated browser contexts with specific launch options, supporting trace collection.

classes.name: CdpContextFactory
classes.description: Creates browser contexts over a Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) connection.

classes.name: RemoteContextFactory
classes.description: Creates browser contexts connected to a remote browser server.

classes.name: PersistentContextFactory
classes.description: Creates persistent browser contexts with user data directories, supporting retries and cleanup.

classes.name: SharedContextFactory
classes.description: Singleton class managing a shared browser context across multiple clients.

methods.name: contextFactory
methods.description: Factory function that returns a specific BrowserContextFactory based on configuration.

methods.name: identityBrowserContextFactory
methods.description: Returns a factory that always provides the same browser context.

methods.name: injectCdpPort
methods.description: Injects a free port into the browser launch options for Chromium.

methods.name: startTraceServer
methods.description: Starts a trace viewer server and logs its URL.

methods.name: createHash
methods.description: Creates a SHA-256 hash of input data, truncated to 7 characters.

methods.name: addInitScript
methods.description: Adds initialization scripts to a browser context.

methods.name: _createUserDataDir
methods.description: Creates a unique user data directory for persistent contexts.

methods.name: _closeBrowserContext
methods.description: Closes a browser context and cleans up resources.

methods.name: _obtainBrowser
methods.description: Retrieves or launches a browser instance, with caching.

methods.name: _doObtainBrowser
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to obtain a browser instance.

methods.name: _doCreateContext
methods.description: Abstract method to create a browser context from a browser instance.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Creates a new browser context, handling browser instantiation and scripts.

methods.name: _closeBrowserContext
methods.description: Closes a browser context and releases resources.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new persistent browser context with retries.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the shared browser context.
